description: The L-shaped stair turning right under a floor with no thickness, designed for 100 mm of headroom: its highest tread, at 3209142.86, is more than 100 mm below the floor at 3456000, but the riser after it rises to the floor itself, so its last step, index 12, needs the opening - every stair comes up through the floor it reaches. Its headroom is 0, less than it declares: FS-LINT-019.
